whatIsAnagram.p1: An anagram is a word or phrase formed by rearranging the letters of a different word or phrase, using all the original letters exactly once. For instance, the letters in 'cinema' can be rearranged to spell 'iceman', and 'silent' forms 'listen'.
whatIsAnagram.p2: Anagrams have been celebrated since ancient Greece, where poet Lycophron created anagrams of royal names. In modern word games—such as Scrabble, Words with Friends, Wordscapes, Jumble, and Wordle—anagramming is the core skill of looking at scrambled tiles on your rack and forming words with given letters to maximize your score.

faq.lead: Answers to common questions on how to unscramble letters, find words, and use our free word solver.
faq.q1: How does the anagram finder work?
faq.a1: Our anagram solver free tool uses optimized integer letter frequency histograms precomputed across over 260,000 tournament words. When you enter your letters, the engine performs lightning-fast bitwise and frequency matching in under 5 milliseconds to find all possible words contained within your rack.
faq.q2: What words can I make with the following letters?
faq.a2: Simply enter your letters into the search box at the top of the page. The tool instantly evaluates all permutations and sub-combinations, grouping results by word length (from 15 letters down to 2-letter words) and scoring each word for Scrabble and Words With Friends.
faq.a3: An anagram is a word or phrase created by rearranging the letters of another word or phrase using all letters exactly once. Famous examples include Cinema ↔ Iceman, Debit card ↔ Bad credit, Astronomer ↔ Moon starer.
faq.a4: Yes! Click the Multi-Word tab at the top of the page. Our anagram solver multiple words engine uses recursive backtracking to discover 2-word and 3-word anagram phrases from any input name, title, or sentence.
faq.q5: How do I search for words with missing letters or find a crossword word?
faq.a5: To find a word with missing letters, insert ? (question mark), *, or press Space in the main search input to represent blank tiles. For fixed-position crossword blanks, use our Pattern Matcher tab (e.g., entering C..T to find CHAT, COAT, COST, CART).
faq.q6: What words can I play with these letters in Scrabble and Words with Friends?
faq.a6: Every word card shows two score badges: SCR (Scrabble point value) and WWF (Words With Friends point value). You can sort results by highest Scrabble score or highest Words With Friends score in the Filters drawer.
faq.q7: How do I find a 7 letter word using these letters (Bingo)?
faq.a7: Enter your 7 rack letters and check Must use ALL letters (Pure Anagrams only) in the Filters drawer, or click the 7 Letters pill in the results toolbar to filter directly to 7-letter words. Playing all 7 letters awards a 50-point Bingo bonus in Scrabble.
faq.q8: How does Anagram Solver UK / WordSolver UK differ from US Scrabble?
faq.a8: International and UK Scrabble uses the CSW (Collins Scrabble Words / SOWPODS) lexicon with 267,000+ words, permitting British spellings like COLOUR and international terms. North American tournaments use TWL06 (83,000+ words). You can select either lexicon under Filters → Game Lexicon.
